ball_classic_d: Cream mine balls: clear and easy to follow.

ball_teal_d: A pearl of teal light with a soft shine.
ball_amber_d: Translucent honey amber that glows from within.
ball_frost_d: A milky ice core with a short, light trail.
ball_obsidian_d: A dark core, a light rim and turquoise cracks.
cannon_ember_d: Blackened iron with a glowing core.
cannon_bronze_d: Warm bronze plates with fine engraving.

noads_inc_1: No ads between runs and levels.
noads_inc_2: Continue at the red line without a video (once per run or level attempt, as usual).

noads_not: Not included: ball and cannon finishes are sold separately.
noads_restore_hint: Bought it before or on another device? Tap Restore Purchases.

support_count.other: You have supported the game {n} times. Thank you!

thanks_text: Your support means a lot and helps Deep Bounce grow.

star_revive_note: Using a second chance limits the result to 2 stars.
star_revive_used: Second chance used: at most 2 stars in this attempt.
restart_level_q: Restart this level from the beginning?

next_star_hint.other: Next star: win in {n} volleys or fewer.

level_failed_text: A stone crossed the red line.
all_clear_text: You reached the Heart of the Mine with {n} of 150 stars. Replay any level for more stars, or dig as deep as you can in Endless Mode.
revive_text: Continue: every stone above the line and up to two rows below it crumbles (no crystals for them). Your balls and upgrades stay. Once per run.
revive_text_level: Continue: every stone above the line and up to two rows below it crumbles. Your balls and upgrades stay. Once per attempt.
revive_stars_note: After a second chance this attempt can earn at most 2 stars.
ad_not_ready: The video is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.
ad_no_reward: The video was closed early, so there is no reward. You can try again.
ad_failed: The video could not be shown. You can try again.
hint_aim: Swipe to aim, release to fire. Break every stone to win.
hint_strength: The number is a stone's strength. Strong stones need many hits.
hint_walls: Bounce off the walls to reach stones from the side.
hint_gaps: Aim through the gaps: balls behind the stones hit them again and again.
hint_rising: Stones rise after every volley. Deal with the lowest ones first.
hint_behind: Get above the stones: balls trapped behind them keep hitting.
hint_pocket: Open the pocket: a ball inside bounces around and hits many times.
hint_upgrade: Every 4 volleys you choose an upgrade: more balls or heavy balls.
hint_heavy: Heavy balls hit hard on a direct hit: aim them at the strongest stones.
hint_copper_final: The last level of the Copper Mine: everything you learned in one shaft.
hint_pockets: Crystal veins hide pockets. Open them and let the balls rattle inside.
hint_groups: Stones come in groups of equal strength: wide ricochets wear down the whole group.
hint_electric: Electric balls spark the nearest stone: great against scattered stones.
hint_big: Big stones take many hits. Keep a stream of balls on them.
hint_combo: Heavy for the big stones, sparks for the rest.
store_noads_d: No ads between runs and levels. Continue at the red line and Double Crystals without a video.
